DNSquachWatch v1.9.3 — ST7789-80MHz, based on SquachWatch v1.40.0.

- Timed per-device Snooze: tap through 10 minutes, 30 minutes, one hour or four hours; the selection confirms three seconds after the last fresh tap. Scanning and logging continue.
- Keeps permanent Ignore and DNSP’s separate Snooze All control. Temporary timers never create another persistent list; a full list reports failure without replacing another active timer.
- Fixes background-character speech font sizing/restoration while preserving DNSP features and ST7789-only scope. Unsupported LoRa, GPS/WiGLE and new-board additions remain excluded.

Keep DNSP Content/v1.5 unchanged. Flash normally without erasing. Serial: 115200 baud.

All 61 native test groups, six receiver simulator modes, Snooze sanitizer tests, driver checks and package checks passed. Physical verification of this exact build remains pending.

Image: 1,962,736 bytes; 3,344 bytes remain in the unchanged app slot. Static RAM: 124,464 bytes, 152 more than v1.9.2.
